# Estate register — SharePoint lists and Power Automate flows

> **GENERATED FILE — do not edit by hand.** Built by `scripts/build-estate-register-views.mjs`
> from `docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/reference/estate-register.json`, which is assembled by
> `scripts/build-estate-register.mjs` from 36 declared sources.
> `npm run estateviews -- --check` fails if this report drifts from the register.

**Every list and every flow this branch holds any statement about, with the provenance of each
statement and every conflict named rather than resolved.** Nothing below is summarised or elided.

## How to read this register before you rely on it

**350 list rows and 818 flow rows are not 350 lists and 818 flows.** Three things a reader must
hold before quoting any number here:

### 1 · A row is an identity, not a proven object

| Lists | Count | What it means |
|---|---:|---|
| Identified by GUID | 327 | Strong identity |
| Identified by site + title only | 23 | Weaker — **33 titles in this tenant name more than one list** |
| Observed in the tenant capture | 327 | Seen on 2026-08-18 |
| Specified and never observed | 23 | Design only. No evidence any of these exists |

| Flows | Count |
|---|---:|
| Rows | 818 |
| Identified by workflow id or flow GUID | 696 |
| Identified by display name only | 122 |
| Of those, sharing a name with an identified row | 19 |
| **Distinct flows, lower bound** | **799** |
| **Distinct flows, upper bound** | **818** |

### 2 · Two identifier spaces that do not resolve

A flow has two identifiers in two spaces — a 36-character dashed Power Automate flow GUID and a 32-hex Logic Apps workflow id. GOV-06 measured the join and found ZERO of 77 exported definitions carrying an id the tenant register knows. Either field may be null. Neither is ever inferred from the other.

| | Count |
|---|---:|
| Rows with a 32-hex Logic Apps workflow id | 56 |
| Rows with a 36-character Power Automate flow GUID | 669 |
| Rows carrying **both** | 29 (3.5%) |

### 3 · Knowing a column exists is five different claims

- **`tenant-observation`** — Read from the tenant. The only basis that evidences existence.
- **`flow-definition`** — A flow definition reads or writes this column. Evidence a flow expects it, not that it exists.
- **`client-code`** — The shipping client reads this column back. Evidence the client expects it.
- **`specification`** — A specification declares it. Not evidence of existence.
- **`generated-seed`** — Generated from configuration in this repository.

| Evidence basis | Column rows | Share |
|---|---:|---:|
| `tenant-observation` | 19 | 4% |
| `flow-definition` | 52 | 11% |
| `client-code` | 30 | 6.3% |
| `specification` | 363 | 76.6% |
| `generated-seed` | 10 | 2.1% |
| **Total** | **474** | |

**Only `tenant-observation` evidences existence, and there are 19 such rows of 474.**
Only tenant-observation evidences existence. An earlier draft mapped internal-field-evidence's `deployed` to observed, which would have asserted 52 columns as seen on the tenant when that word means a flow definition writes to them.

## What this register is not

Current tenant state. Nothing here was read from the tenant at build time. The newest observation of the list estate is 2026-08-18; of the flow estate, 2026-09-26. Neither is today.

### Known divergences, stated rather than smoothed

#### GOV-06 — flow identity

**Zero of the exported definitions carry an id the tenant register knows; 13 of 77 match on normalised display name.**

A flow row may exist twice in this register — once under each identifier space — and the register cannot merge them without fabricating the join.

Measured in `docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/registers/flow-definition-map.json`.

#### governance-field-count — the governance field table

**The workbook extraction carries 97 field rows; the corrected table carries 98 (delta +1).**

Quoting one as "the" field count contradicts the other. The register uses the corrected table for field rows and reports both counts here.

Measured in `docs/reference/sharepoint-provisioning-spec.json`.

#### capture-age — every observed list row

**The only tenant observation of the list estate is dated 2026-08-18.**

GOV-09 records rows written after it and GOV-11 records resources reported created after it. "Observed" here means observed then, not now.

Measured in `docs/reference/sharepoint-list-index.json`.

#### reading-breadth — the two tenant readings of the flow estate

**The 2026-09-18 Flow Management API reading covers 20 flows, requested by identifier. The 2026-09-26 "List My Flows" export covers 648. They are not the same population and neither supersedes the other: the first carries trigger authentication type per flow, which the second does not.**

A flow absent from the narrow reading is not absent from the tenant. A flow present in the wide export is not therefore this estate's. Rows carry both statements and the register merges neither.

Measured in `docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/deployment/internal/evidence/2026-09-18-tenant-flow-inventory.json and docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/audits/flow-usage-analysis-2026-09-26.json`.

#### mailer-lists-unobserved — the mailer platform

**The mailer declares 8 lists and 7 flows under contract dgo-mail/2.0, on https://nitdanigeria.sharepoint.com/sites/NITDADGO-EAAACTIVITYTRACKING. The tenant capture of 2026-08-18 predates the platform, so no source in this branch has observed any of them.**

Those rows are specified, not observed, however the platform behaves in service. The mailer's own setup provisions the lists on first run; nothing here evidences that it has.

Measured in `mailer/flows/flows.catalogue.json`.

**`docs/reference/sharepoint-list-index.json`** — The 2026-08-18 capture of every list and library visible across five site collections. The only source in this branch that observed the tenant rather than describing it.

> ⚠ Dated. Anything created, renamed or deleted since is invisible to it — GOV-09 records rows written 13 days after it, and GOV-11 records three resources reported created 23 days after.

**`docs/reference/governance-list-registry.json`** — The GOV-01 decision: which 10 governance lists are authoritative and which 17 instances retire.

**`docs/reference/sharepoint-provisioning-spec.json`** — The governance provisioning specification — what the 10 governance lists must carry.

> ⚠ Carries TWO field tables. `tables.Fields.records` is the verbatim workbook extraction; `fields` at the top level is that extraction with GOV-03 and GOV-08 applied by scripts/correct-governance-fields.mjs. The counts differ and the register reports both.

> ⚠ NOT BUILT. No list in it exists on any tenant. Every row is intention.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/deployment/sharepoint/portal-field-spec.json`** — The document portal and correspondence-gateway lists, with a captured state per column.

> ⚠ Mixed. Each column carries capturedState — LIVE means observed on the tenant, PENDING means specified and not provisioned. The register keeps the distinction per column.

**`docs/reference/internal-proof-ledger.json`** — The platform owner's 2026-09-24 decision that the internal platform and the Correspondence Gateway keep SEPARATE proof ledgers, with the one list that decision requires.

> ⚠ listId is null and status is AWAITING_PROVISIONING. The list does not exist yet.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/deployment/internal/evidence/2026-09-24-tenant-remediation-verified.json`** — Two tenant changes verified on 2026-09-24 from fresh artefacts: SCAN_INTAKE is Tenant-authenticated again, and FETCH_ALL refuses the caller it served on 2026-09-22.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/registers/FLOW_REGISTRY_SEED.json`** — Every flow the estate knows in one row each, in DGO_HTTPFlowRegistry column shape — 109 registry rows, 168 dependency rows and the 45 lists those dependencies name. The seed GOV-06 names as its own resolution.

> ⚠ The two registry lists it targets are not provisioned, and it says so. Its rows are a seed for a list that does not exist; the columns it leaves empty are the ones no evidence can fill.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/reference/REGISTRY_DECISIONS.json`** — The four REQUIRED registry columns that need a person, with what can be proposed from evidence for each of 109 flows and what cannot.

> ⚠ Proposals, explicitly not decisions. Nothing here has been ratified by anyone.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/registers/flow-identity-crosswalk.json`** — Each contract key set against both identifier domains at once: the application workflow id the endpoint register keys on, and the tenant flow ids that serve it.

> ⚠ It states the relationship between the two domains rather than asserting one resolves to the other. Keys with more than one candidate are counted as such, not collapsed.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/reference/contract-key-flow-map.json`** — The contract key → flow mapping supplied by the platform owner on 2026-09-24, for 24 keys, with a confidence on each row.

> ⚠ A statement of INTENT — expectedFlowName is the field's own word. For what serves traffic today the file directs the reader to the endpoint register instead.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/reference/contract-key-flow-reconciliation.json`** — Every key the owner map names, set against what the estate is wired to, with the difference classified per row: 15 already wired as named, 5 answered by the map, 4 naming a different flow.

> ⚠ It picks no winner. Each row carries a verdict and an action, and nothing is applied.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/reference/flow-package-provenance.json`** — Each supplied export package joined by its own flow id to the 2026-09-18 tenant reading and to this repository's recorded exports — 20 packages, with import hazards named.

> ⚠ The join is on the dashed flow id, the only identifier all three readings carry. No package carries a workflow id that any wired endpoint knows.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/reference/connector/connector-register.json`** — Every connector and connection used by every flow action and trigger in this repository: 222 flow labels, 324 artefacts, 4131 actions walked, and the 59 SharePoint site/list targets they address.

> ⚠ Keyed by flow LABEL, not by either identifier. A label is how the artefact names itself, so rows join to this register by name and are held as name-only where no identifier appears beside them.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/reference/authorisation-gates.json`** — Every place in the estate where an authorisation decision branches on a constant — a gate that cannot return false whatever the request carries.

> ⚠ It says what it does not claim: that a flow with no finding authorises correctly. It asks only whether a decision CAN go both ways.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/deployment/rotation/rotation-worksheet.json`** — Which of the 25 endpoint keys need a new trigger URL after the ITEM-22 rotation and which do not, computed per flow from the disclosed signatures.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/deployment/sharepoint/portal-wiring.json`** — Which flow reads and writes which portal list, what crosses into the internal estate and where, and what is not yet wired — 7 endpoints, the bridge, and every measured crossing.

> ⚠ The portal estate is a trust boundary in this file: a crossing is recorded whether or not it is accepted, and its state says which.

**`docs/reference/operations-manifest.json`** — A static extraction of the internal client's own endpoint table — 10 endpoints, each with the workflow id, method and trigger the shipping page calls, and the functions that call it.

> ⚠ Read from the client, so it evidences what the client calls, not what answers. Dated 2026-07-30 and the oldest reading the register holds.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/contracts/deployed/`** — Definitions exported from Power Automate. Authoritative about what each flow contains.

**`docs/reference/foundational/flows/definitions/`** — Definitions held under the foundational lineage, from an earlier release.

> ⚠ Lineage. These describe an earlier release and are not the live estate.

**`mailer/flows/definitions/`** — The seven mailer flow bodies as this repository builds them, contract dgo-mail/2.0.

> ⚠ Built here and installed by the mailer's own setup. A body in this directory is what the setup creates, not a reading of what the tenant runs.

**`docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/surfaces/governance/`** — The four governance flows as corrected in this repository, not yet applied to the tenant.

> ⚠ Corrections. The tenant still runs the uncorrected bodies until Step 4 is executed.
